physical.title: album; painting; papercut
physical.summary:
Portrait of a coban, a shepherd; painting mounted onto an album folio, B side. Carrying thick club-like shepherd's stick, cased knife hanging from his belt. Wearing short white jacket and shirt, wide blue trousers, black boots, white hat with long brim divided into four ends. Unshaven stubbly chin.Orange lily cut-outs on either side. Inscribed. Album contains sixty folios with fifty-nine paintings of figures, and additional découpages,  including floral and vegetal decoration in some margins.
Ink and opaque watercolour, with découpage on paper. Album covered with green leather.
